steps.instruction: Prick the skin of each potato with a fork in several places.
Bake the potatoes for 30 minutes, until soft.
steps.spoken: Bake the potatoes for 30 to sixty minutes, until soft. Larger potatoes take longer.

steps.instruction: Peel the stems of 3 broccoli stalks.
Steam the broccoli just until tender.
Chop the broccoli into small pieces.
Cut the baked potatoes in half.
Scoop the insides of the potatoes into a bowl with the broccoli.
Add 1/4 cup of milk, 3/4 cup of cheese, salt and pepper.
Mash together until the mixture is pale green with dark green flecks.
Put the potato mixture into the potato skins.
Sprinkle the remaining 1/4 cup of cheese on top.
